FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 Signals Bullish Momentum Amid Mixed Risk Sentiment
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above the 20‑day MA at 160.15, suggesting near‑term bullish bias.
Geopolitical tension in the Middle East adds safe‑haven demand, but USD strength outweighs JPY flow.
Key technical resistance lies around 161.00; a break could target 162.50.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds above MA20 with bullish bias; watch for break above 161.00 targeting 162.50.
FX.comment: Bullish bias supported by price above MA20 and favorable yield differential.
